notes.title: Fixed Text Errors and Non-Functional VSync
notes.notes:
Dear valued players,

We sincerely apologize for the poor gaming experience some of you have encountered. We are taking your feedback to heart and are committed to improving the game for you.

We have carefully reviewed the issues you've reported and have identified the root causes. Our team is working diligently to resolve them as quickly as possible.

In the meantime, we have addressed several text and functional bugs. If you have experienced these issues, please try updating your game to receive the fixes.

Here is the complete patch log:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain languages were not displaying correctly. The following languages are now available in the game: Korean, Portuguese, Thai, and Arabic.
[*] Fixed an issue where the VSync function was not working as intended.
[*] Fixed various instances of garbled or incorrect text.
[/list]

We are still actively working on addressing the control issues, unresponsiveness, crashes, and other problems you have reported. We will release further updates as soon as these fixes are ready. Please stay tuned for our upcoming announcements.

Thank you for your continued support. We will do our utmost to provide you with the best possible gaming experience.

Sincerely,
Cotton Game

notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

Mark your calendars! Reviver, our latest creation, launches on Steam January 9th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239130

Experience a poignant love story that spans a lifetime, from youthful exuberance to the golden years.ːDaisyGJː
